continuousYawProof: All candidate XZ vertices lie in convex hull of source aircraft-only XZ points. Rotation preserves containment, therefore every horizontal support plane/AABB is contained for every yaw, not only sampled yaw. Candidate Y interval is also contained. This is an envelope test, not per-triangle volume containment.
